post.description:
Create an employee

Custom Fields
-------------

You can update employee custom fields by using the generated "internal_name" of the employee field that you have in PeopleForce. This unique field name is automatically generated when you create a custom field, and is returned by the GET /employee_fields endpoint.

For example if you have a field labelled "Tax number" in PeopleForce,it will autogenerated an internal name called "tax_number",  you can then use within your request along with other system attributes of the employee, for example "first_name"

```JSON
{
  "first_name": "Andrew",
  "tax_number": "123123"
}
```

get.description: Retrieve a list of timesheet entries. This endpoint allows you to get a comprehensive and organized view of all recorded work activities and hours for a given period.

parameters.name: starts_on
parameters.description: This filter allows users to specify the starting date of the date range for which they want to retrieve timesheet entries. It helps narrow down the entries to those that fall within or after the specified date

parameters.name: ends_on
parameters.description: Similar to "starts_on," this filter enables users to set the ending date of the date range for timesheet entry retrieval. It restricts entries to those that fall within or before the specified date.

parameters.name: employee_ids[]
parameters.description: This filter allows users to specify one or more employee IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific employees. It restricts the list to entries associated with the selected employees.

parameters.name: position_ids[]
parameters.description: Users can use this filter to specify one or more position IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific job positions or roles. It narrows down the entries to those related to the selected positions.

parameters.name: team_ids[]
parameters.description: This filter allows users to specify one or more team IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific teams or workgroups. It focuses on entries associated with the chosen teams.

parameters.name: department_ids[]
parameters.description: Users can use this filter to specify one or more department IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific organizational departments. It limits the list to entries linked to the selected departments.

parameters.name: location_ids[]
parameters.description: Users can use this filter to specify one or more location IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific physical or geographical locations. It focuses on entries associated with the selected locations.

parameters.name: division_ids[]
parameters.description: Similar to other ID filters, this filter allows users to specify one or more division IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific divisions or subunits within the organization.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This filter allows users to specify the type of timesheet entries they want to retrieve. The allowed values are "working" and "break"

parameters.name: project_ids[]
parameters.description: This filter allows users to specify one or more project IDs to filter timesheet entries by specific projects. It focuses on entries associated with the chosen projects.

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: This filter restricts timesheet entries to those whose timesheet is in one of the specified statuses. The allowed values are unsubmitted, pending, approved, and rejected.

delete.description: Delete bulk timesheet entries for a given employee. Can optional delete via timesheet entry IDs or by a provide datetime range.  If provided a datetime range, timesheet entries will be deleted based on their starting time.

starts_at.description: Delete timesheet entries that starting between this starting datetime. Value should be a valid Unix timestamp.

ends_at.description: Delete timesheet entries that starting between this ending datetime. Value should be a valid Unix timestamp.

timesheet_entry_ids.description: To delete specific timesheet entries via their ID.
